_note: One fin station, design v2. Replace every value marked estimate with the CATIA mass properties. Units: kg, mm, kg*mm^2. Fin CG: x along the span from the hinge axis, c across the chord (fin body is c from -125 to 0). Cylinder CG: distance from the anchor pin along the piston axis. Rod CG: distance from the rod-eye pin back along the piston axis.

fin_inertia_hinge.source: estimate from wall segments when null; inertia about the hinge pin axis

cyl_mass.source: estimate: steel barrel 60/48 x 478 plus caps and eye

rod_mass.source: estimate: rod 30 x 440 plus piston and eye

no_load_speed_m_s.source: assumption: sets the flow-restriction damping of the actuator model
